<div class="card-body">
'''Rebel Trooper''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].







<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">反乱軍兵員</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">能力値＞２を持つ反乱軍と同じ位置カードに配備する場合、配備コストなし。</span>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">コレリアン・コルベットの兵士、オルデラン出身のチャド・ヒルズ少尉は、打倒帝国に生涯を捧げた忠実なる反乱軍志願兵の代表的人物といえる。宇宙船内及び地上戦闘技術を持つ。</span>''
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Rebel personnel.

'''Card text:''' Deploys at no deploy cost when deployed to the same location card as a Rebel with ability greater than 2.

'''Lore:''' Corellian Corvette soldier Ensign Chad Hilse, from Alderaan, exemplifies the loyal Rebel volunteers who have devoted their lives to defeating the Empire. He has skills in combat aboard starships and on the ground.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says the same location card as a Rebel with ability greater than 2. The English says the same site as one of your Rebels with ability greater than 2.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Rebel Trooper]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>
